Chapter 269 - 269 Invitation; Verification Completed!

Chapter 269 - 269 Invitation; Verification Completed!

269 Invitation; Verification Completed!

Ling Rou was puzzled by Lin Fan’s words.

Did she not just say that Xin Mei Entertainment did not call her?

Could it be that Lin Fan knew someone from Xin Mei Entertainment?

It seemed like… it was really possible.

At this moment, Lin Fan’s phone on the table rang.

Lin Fan looked at the caller ID. It was an unknown number.

He did not hesitate to answer the call.

“Hello?” Lin Fan said.

“Hello… Is this Mr. Lin?” A respectful voice sounded from the phone.

Lin Fan said, “It’s me. And you are?”

“Hello, Mr. Lin. I’m Wang Haohua, the chairman of Xin Mei Entertainment.” The voice on the phone became even more respectful.

“Oh, Chairman Dong, what’s the matter?” Lin Fan asked.

“I just found out that you acquired Xin Mei Entertainment today…” Wang Haohua said carefully. “Do you think we need to hold a meeting between the higher-ups and the artistes? You could guide the company’s future development…”

Back then, the general manager of Imperial Hotel, the chairman of the Yinshan Group, the chairman of Xiao Wu Wholesale City, and the others had all sent similar invitations to Lin Fan.

However, Lin Fan rejected all of them.

He had no interest in such meetings.

This time, there was no surprise.

“There’s no need. The company will continue to develop as usual. I won’t be hands-on regarding the management,” Lin Fan said calmly.

When Wang Haohua heard this, he was overjoyed.

He had his own plans for the future development of Xin Mei Entertainment.

If the new boss needed to make adjustments, it would definitely not be a good thing.

Wang Haohua’s tone did not change, but his attitude became more respectful.

“Alright…”

Wang Haohua’s heart skipped a beat.

He finally understood… why the publicity for the concert at Jiangbei City Stadium was so intense.

He understood why it was done so lavishly.

All of this… It was all because of his new boss, Lin Fan!

He got Penguin Group, Little Tanuki Group, and Alphabet Group to vigorously promote it…

He spent hundreds of millions on the concert venue…

This boss of his was much more powerful than he had imagined!

After a while, Wang Haohua said, “I understand… I’ll definitely handle this to your satisfaction.”

“Alright, that’s it,” Lin Fan said.

After saying that, he hung up the phone.

At this moment, Ling Rou, who was sitting beside him, was completely stunned.

It was because she had heard everything that was said over the phone.

She was not eavesdropping on purpose.

It was just that she was sitting too close to Lin Fan. In addition, there was no other sound in the entire villa. Under such circumstances, it was difficult for her not to hear him.

Lin Fan acquired Xin Mei Entertainment today?!

First, he helped her hold a concert at all costs.

Then, in order to help her enter the entertainment industry, he directly acquired one of the top three entertainment companies in Hua Nation…

Ling Rou looked at Lin Fan who was sitting in front of her. Her beautiful eyes started to well up with tears as a teardrop rolled down her face.

These were tears of gratitude and happiness!

No one had ever treated her so well in her life.

Lin Fan wiped her tears away and asked, “Why are you crying?”

Ling Rou did not say anything. She used the most primitive and instinctive way to answer Lin Fan.

…

About two hours later, Lin Fan and Ling Rou slowly separated.

At this moment, Ling Rou’s phone rang again.

Ling Rou adjusted her clothes and answered the call.

“Hello, is this Ms. Ling Rou?” A familiar voice came from the phone.

Ling Rou replied, “Yes, this is Ling Rou… May I ask who you are?”

The voice on the phone became even more respectful.

“Hello, Ms. Ling! I’m Wang Haohua, the chairman of Xin Mei Entertainment. I had a call with Mr. Lin earlier…

“We’ve prepared the best manager, makeup artist, and fashion designer for you. We’ve also allocated roles in many movies, television shows, and programs for you…

“When will you be free to come to the company to make the arrangements?”

Ling Rou finally understood why the voice sounded familiar.

He was the chairman of Xin Mei Entertainment!

A manager, a makeup artist, a fashion designer, as well as roles in movies, TV shows, and programs… She could have her pick!

What kind of treatment was this?!

Ling Rou suppressed the excitement in her heart and said, “I can come over anytime!”

Wang Haohua thought for a moment and said, “Then… Is tomorrow okay with you?”

“Of course!” Ling Rou said.

As soon as she hung up, Ling Rou’s phone rang again.

This time, it was her mother.

Even though Ling Rou previously worked in the bar every day, her family was still worried about her.

In fact, her family was very strict.

Her parents had been worried for the entire night since she did not go home last night.

Therefore, when she received the call, Ling Rou chose to answer it and go home.

Regarding this…

Lin Fan also expressed his support.

After the two of them were intimate for a while, Lin Fan drove the Mercedes-Benz and brought Ling Rou back.

Lin Fan did not stay outside for long. He returned to the Coiling Dragon Villa and lay on the soft sofa, playing with his phone.

Princeton University, America.

These days, Jeffrey had given up on all activities and classes… He spent almost the entire time in the Institute for Advanced Study, carefully checking the complex Hail Conjecture.

It was not until today that he finally completed the thesis and sent the results to Annual Mathematics.

If it were an ordinary person, they would definitely be exhausted after working hard for a long time.

However, Jeffrey’s face was filled with excitement.

“Hey! Professor Jeffrey, why haven’t I seen you for days?” Professor Adivan said.

“Because I’m in the midst of witnessing something big!” Jeffrey said.

“Something big?” Adivan was puzzled.

“Hail conjecture! Someone has solved the Hail Conjecture!” Jeffrey said excitedly.

“What? Who? They came up with the answer process?” Adivan said anxiously.

“Hey, don’t get so worked up, my friend!” Jeffrey laughed. “I’m not too sure who it is. As for the content… You can wait for the next issue of Annual Mathematics.”

Even though there was a detailed explanation process in his email, it would be against the rules if he showed it to others.

Of course, more importantly, if he were to show it to Adivan, how could he act all mysterious afterward?
